sentences.en: I did not miss my purse till I got home.
sentences.zh: 我直到回到家才发现钱包不见了。

sentences.en: The noise grew fainter, till it was heard no more.
sentences.zh: 噪音越来越小，直到完全听不见。

sentences.en: You never know what you can do till you try.
sentences.zh: 除非你尝试过，否则你永远不知道你能做到什么。
